pictures.notes: A3, 2:1, top + iso + right views, title block 'UNREVIEWED', 52.3 / 21 / 3.7 plus both callouts. The ordinate texts at the bottom of the top view (0, 1,61, 4,8, 7,96 ...) overlap each other as the layout warning said. Y position of holes not dimensioned. Board occupies the left half; right half is the iso. Usable draft for an enclosure maker except the clash.

Turn 2 reply: top + front only, 2:1, overall dims, the four-line note at lower right; the board fills about 15 % of the sheet width. No callouts, no hole dimensions. Readable but unhelpful; the person's complaint 'only a small part of the sheet' is justified.

Turn 3: iso + right view at 5:1 fills A3 and is the most legible sheet, but it has no top view and no hole data, and the title '(立體與側視，5:1)' overprints PART NO. 'RPi-Pico' (the assistant noticed). Not a deliverable.

Final sheet chosen by the person: top view with 52,3 and 21, side view 3.7 detached from the top view and placed to the right (third-angle projection not respected visually for the user), four-line hole note with 11.4 x 47, title no longer overlaps. Clean, no collisions; board small (2:1), text of the note about 3 mm high. Acceptable draft; missing what the person asked for (dimension lines between the mounting holes, board lying landscape).

problems.what: (still open from rounds 1 and 2) drawing_make_views cannot dimension chosen holes: no centre-to-centre dimension, no Y ordinates above 16 distinct y values, no option to add a dimension or a hole table. The mounting hole spacing, the one thing the case maker needs, can only go in as free text.
problems.evidence: Turn 3: 'the tool only supports overall and auto; cannot draw a dimension between two holes'; turn 4: 'dimension lines were not drawn'.
problems.fix: drawing_make_views: add `hole_dimensions` (a list of hole groups or ids to dimension centre-to-centre, or 'mounting' = the largest through-hole group) and let `dimensions=auto` fall back to a ordinate chain of the largest group when the all-holes count exceeds 16; or an automatic hole table (X, Y, diameter) block on the sheet.

problems.what: dimensions=overall is the only way to remove the overlapping ordinates, and it also removes the hole callouts; the person cannot have overall size, hole sizes and positions on one A3 sheet.
problems.evidence: Turns 2 and 4 calls: dimensions 'overall'; final sheet has no '4x Ø2.1 THRU'.
problems.fix: Add dimensions='callouts' (overall + hole callouts, no ordinates) or thin the ordinates automatically (keep the mounting group, skip pitch rows).

problems.what: No view orientation/rotation option: the upright board limits A3 to 2:1 and the 5:1 landscape layout the person wants (board long side along the sheet's long side) is impossible. Scale list is ISO only (no 3:1, 4:1) so the gap between 2:1 and 5:1 cannot be used.
problems.evidence: Turn 3: 'top view in the STEP is upright; the tool has no rotate option'; 5:1 refused with drawing.layout_failed.
problems.fix: drawing_make_views: `rotate_view` (0/90/180/270 degrees per view) or auto-rotate when it makes the part fit a larger standard scale; allow free scale such as 3:1.

problems.what: Claims an experiment that was not run ('I also tried to compose a 90 degree rotation with mirrors').
problems.evidence: Turn 4 text vs transcript.json turn 4 tools: drawing_make_views, Read only.
problems.fix: Model-side: no skill change fixes this; the eng-toolkit skill could say 'do not say you tried something unless a tool call shows it'.

problems.what: Decimal separators are mixed on one sheet: dimension texts '52,3', '4,8' use a comma, callouts 'Ø2.1' and notes use a point.
problems.evidence: rendered sheets: '52,3' next to '4× Ø2.1 THRU'.
problems.fix: One decimal separator for all generated dimension texts (point), or a `decimal` argument.

problems.what: Note text height cannot be set; the person's last request (bigger note text) cannot be fulfilled and the assistant could only point to editing the DXF.
problems.evidence: Turn 5: 'drawing_make_views has no text height parameter'.

problems.what: eng-drawing does not tell the assistant the working set of options when ordinates collide on small parts (notes carry the hole positions; use views=top,right,iso; dimensions=overall loses callouts). The assistant found the notes route itself but lost the callouts without saying so.
problems.evidence: Final sheet has no hole callouts; message says only 'no dimension lines'.
problems.fix: eng-drawing skill: one line 'dimensions=overall also removes hole callouts: if you switch to it, say so and put hole sizes in notes'.

problems.what: drawing_make_views has no inline_image option, so the PNG reaches the assistant only through Read and the user only as a path; I cannot see in the transcript whether the person's PNGs were also shown in the reply. The person did see them (rasterised by the harness) and every path was given in words.
problems.evidence: Tool schema: no inline_image; persona: 'the 0, 1.61, 4.8 pile up'.
problems.fix: Optional inline_image on drawing_make_views like geometry_view has.

what_worked: eng-drawing and eng-toolkit loaded before the first tool call; first call already A3, 4 views, title, part number, notes; hole list checked against holes_total (47) and with the pin rows described by pitch.
The assistant opened its own PNGs with Read and reported what was wrong (ordinate overlap, title over PART NO.) before the person did.
Found the notes argument to put 11.4 x 47 and the hole groups on the sheet; separated 'my arithmetic' from tool output.
Told the person plainly what the tool could not do (dimension between holes, rotation, scale > 2:1 on A3) instead of pretending; offered DXF editing as the real way out.
